title: The space of a quotient stack is the quotient of the space of the covering by the relation coming from the groupoid
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a flat groupoid in algebraic spaces the space of the quotient stack is the quotient of the space of the covering by the equivalence relation induced by the groupoid space (author lemma at source lines 4125-4132, label lemma-points-presentation). The proof (source lines 4134-4155) uses that the quotient morphism is surjective on points, identifies the groupoid space as the fibre product of that morphism with itself, and reads the equivalence relation off the induced map on squares (proof lines 4134-4154). The identification of the relation through the fibre product description is the content. H3.
